engines.notes: Prefer exact book/edition pages with explicit PDF download links; preserve edition metadata and rights evidence.
Search title+author, resolve concrete PDF files through item metadata, then validate with qpdf.
Use edition/work metadata and availability to locate Internet Archive identifiers; do not bulk-download Open Library data.
Use manuscript records, IIIF manifests and provenance as discovery/evidence; acquire only where the record permits it.
Use volume metadata and access status to improve edition matching; do not treat search results as redistribution permission.
Metadata cross-check only; especially useful for modern editions and identifiers, not as a primary Arabic heritage PDF source.

forbidden_shortcut: Never persist a discovery URL as an acquired book. An acquired record requires an actual validated PDF file.
